resources.allowTrivial: One initial GPU frame and eight requested deterministic frames must complete, including reversals and a stop.
The first actual GPU frame has current equal to previous.
The static sub-draw must have zero measured velocity.
The moved authored sub-draw must cover at least 100 non-zero velocity pixels.
Every rendered frame must match signed current-minus-previous NDC within 0.05 pixel, allowing half-float quantization.
The moving instance stops on frame seven; no extra stale frame of motion is allowed.
Pixels outside the conservative moving-sphere rectangle, including the static geometry, must remain still.
The rendered moving colour silhouette must agree with the current pose within half a pixel on every frame.
The independently rasterized binary coverage must contain the moving surface in every actual frame.
Every covered moving-surface pixel must match signed current-minus-previous NDC within the fixed half-float allowance, independently of lighting and colour intensity.
Every pixel outside the exact moving coverage attachment, including all visible wall pixels at the silhouette, must have zero velocity.
Every actual frame must include covered shaded pixels that the rejected brightness/chroma mask would have excluded.
